pages.title: Glacial Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bows, Crossbows$(br2)§lEffect: §r Draw speed is halved. The main arrow flies at roughly 3.2x speed and scatters 12 sub-arrows; impacts deal area damage and pull nearby enemies toward the hit point. Conflicts with Cloud Bow Arts and Ancient Cloud Bow Arts.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
